data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for HyperSDK enabling payment orchestration via dynamic modules.
data.what_it_does: Provides integration with HyperSDK for payment orchestration, dynamic modules, transaction processing, and user payment profile management. Supports rendering payment options via full-screen views, containers, or embedded widgets.
use_when: You need to integrate Juspay HyperSDK payment orchestration into a Flutter application.
You require dynamic payment modules and multi-tenant payment handling on Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You are looking for a standard Stripe or generic in-app purchase implementation not tied to Juspay.
You want a pure Dart payment solution without native Android/iOS native setup requirements.
strengths: Supports multiple payment widgets, container views, and full-screen processes.
Provides flexibility for Android and iOS configuration including Swift Package Manager and CocoaPods.
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration on both Android (ext properties, FragmentActivity) and iOS (MerchantConfig.json, build scripts).
AGPL-3.0 license may pose restrictions depending on your application's licensing requirements.
data.setup_notes: Requires modifying root build.gradle on Android, extending FlutterFragmentActivity, adding MerchantConfig.json on iOS, and setting up Podfile or Swift Package Manager build scripts.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: If your target gateway is Stripe rather than Juspay.

alternatives.name: adyen_checkout
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are integrating Adyen payment processing instead of Juspay.
